# Landing Page Copy (fixture)

Write landing-page copy from the product brief, following the OpenDesign
voice rules: one promise per screen, concrete outcome before feature list,
and a single primary CTA per viewport.

## Workflow

1. Read the brief and name the single promise in one sentence.
2. Draft hero (headline + subhead + CTA), three supporting sections, and a
   closing CTA.
3. Self-check: no filler adjectives; every claim maps to a brief fact.
